title: 第5章 朝天宗第6章 入定
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 沉闷的钟声响起，很快一道身影就从牌坊后的小石路走出。
“什么人！”
一个身形高挑的男子走了出来，他身着灰色的道袍，眉目刚毅。
只看见巫未央这么一个小孩，他有些吃惊，“你是？”
巫未央揪着双手，心里紧张语气却平稳，“您好，我来这是想拜师求学的，我叫巫未央。”
男子愣了一下，说道，“你想拜入我们宗门？”
巫未央连连点头。
男子沉思片刻，“我们这是修仙门派，若想拜入宗门，需得拥有灵根。”
末了，他怕小孩不知道灵根还补充了一句，“灵根是修仙必须要的根骨资质。”
他以为小孩是听了什么话被忽悠了，做着修仙的梦。
巫未央闻言，立刻说道，“我知道的，我测过灵根，是......五灵根。”
巫未央到后面的声音越来越弱，之前两个宗门一听到她五灵根就说不收了。
男子没想到她还真的有灵根，虽然是最差的五灵根。
“你知道自己是五灵根，想必也知道它在修仙界的地位吧。”
男子开口。
巫未央听了，心里有些失落。
“不过进我们宗门倒是不限制灵根。”
没想到男子又补了一句，“但如果三年内，你没能引气入体，就会被逐出宗门。”
“这也是没办法的，我们是小宗门，没那么多资源供养弟子。”
巫未央完全没在意他后面的话，欣喜万分，“进了宗门我一定努力修炼。”
男子看她亮晶晶的眼眸，不忍心打击她，“那你先随我进门吧。”
“对了，我姓唐，唐落天，你叫我唐师兄便好。”
“唐师兄好！”
听着她的呼喊，唐落天笑了笑，“走吧。”
跟着唐落天穿过长长的小石路，他们来到了山的背面。
朝天宗山头在山群偏深处的地方，山不高，矮胖矮胖的，背面像是被纵横两剑削去了一半，朝天宗建在这削出来的平台上。
中间是一间大大的房屋，房屋前修出一块平整的地面，而后面紧接着修了几排小屋。
这就是朝天宗全部的建筑了。
这看起来与村中的景象没什么差别。
唐落天虽然见巫未央表情没有变化，但总觉得有些心虚，咳嗽两声道，“门面比较重要，自然要修得好一些。”
他在解释门内门外差别如此大的原因。
巫未央点头，“唐师兄说得很有道理。”
像她，每去一个宗门都要整理一下仪容，她自然也觉得门面重要。
见她是打心底赞同他的话，唐落天有些高兴，“走，带你去见掌门。”
唐落天将她带到了中间的房屋，里面只放了一张长案，以及数个蒲团，像个学堂。
一个老者正坐在长案后，闭目养神。
“落天，何人敲响了古钟？”
唐落天双手一抱，“掌门，是有个小孩前来拜师。”
content_en:
The dull bell rang, and soon a figure walked out of the small stone path behind the archway.
"Who!"
A tall man walked out. He was wearing a gray robe and had resolute eyebrows.
Seeing only a child like Wu Weiyang, he was a little surprised, "Who are you?"
Wu Weiyang clasped his hands, feeling nervous but speaking calmly, "Hello, I'm here to study as a disciple. My name is Wu Weiyang."
The man was stunned for a moment and said, "You want to join our sect?"
Wu Weiyang nodded repeatedly.
The man pondered for a moment, "We are a cultivating sect. If you want to join the sect, you must have spiritual roots."
Finally, he was afraid that the children would not know about spiritual roots and added, "Spiritual roots are the necessary qualifications for cultivating immortals."
He thought that the child had been deceived by something and was dreaming of cultivating immortality.
Wu Weiyang heard the words and immediately said, "I know, I have tested the spiritual roots, and they are...five spiritual roots."
Wu Weiyang's voice became weaker and weaker as she went to the back. The two previous sects refused to give up as soon as they heard about her five spirit roots.
The man didn't expect that she really had spiritual roots, even though they were the worst of the five spiritual roots.
"You know that you have five spiritual roots, so you must also know its status in the world of immortality."
The man spoke.
Wu Weiyang felt a little disappointed after hearing this.
"But there are no restrictions on spiritual roots when entering our sect."
Unexpectedly, the man added, "But if you fail to draw Qi into your body within three years, you will be expelled from the sect."
"There's nothing we can do about it. We are a small sect and we don't have so many resources to support our disciples."
Wu Weiyang didn't pay attention to what he said next, and was extremely happy, "I will definitely work hard to practice after entering the sect."
The man looked at her sparkling eyes and couldn't bear to attack her, "Then follow me in first."
"By the way, my surname is Tang, Tang Luotian. You can just call me Senior Brother Tang."
"Hello, Senior Brother Tang!"
Listening to her call, Tang Luotian smiled and said, "Let's go."
Following Tang Luotian through the long stone road, they came to the back of the mountain.
The top of the Chaotian Sect is located deep in the mountains. The mountain is not high, and it is short and fat. The back seems to have been cut in half by two vertical and horizontal swords. The Chaotian Sect is built on the platform cut out.
In the middle is a large house, with a flat ground built in front of the house, and several rows of huts built immediately behind.
This is all the buildings of Chaotian Sect.
It looked no different from the scene in the village.
Although Tang Luotian saw that Wu Weiyang's expression did not change, he still felt a little guilty. He coughed twice and said, "The appearance is more important, so it is natural to cultivate it better."
He was explaining why there was such a big difference inside and outside the door.
Wu Weiyang nodded, "Senior Brother Tang makes sense."
Like her, she has to tidy up her appearance every time she goes to a sect, so she naturally feels that appearance is important.
Seeing that she agreed with his words from the bottom of her heart, Tang Luotian was a little happy, "Let's go, I will take you to see the leader."
Tang Luotian took her to the middle room, which contained only a long table and several futons, like a school.
An old man was sitting behind a long desk, closing his eyes and concentrating.
"Luotian, who rang the ancient bell?"
Tang Luotian hugged him with both hands and said, "Master, there is a child who comes to be his disciple."
"Huh?"
